summary: All 157 files in this work unit contain formal mathematical content related to level-1 modular forms from the LMFDB. They include: (1) definitions of modular forms as linear combinations of Eisenstein series monomials with rational/integer coefficients, (2) minimal polynomials of Hecke eigenvalues (algebraic numbers) over ℂ with degree/root lemmas, (3) precomputed q-expansion coefficients (rational and integer), (4) computational certificates using `decide +kernel` verifying symbolic evaluations match precomputed values, (5) coefficient lemmas for n=0..9, and (6) uniqueness theorems via `ModularForm.eq_of_sturm_bound`. The 'part' files (e.g., Weight_16_part_0.lean) contain integer-arithmetic certificates for individual pieces; main weight files (e.g., Weight_18.lean, Weight_44.lean, Weight_66.lean, Weight_160.lean, Weight_192.lean) combine pieces into full forms with algebraic coefficients and prove uniqueness. All files contain formal definitions, lemmas, theorems, and proofs — no file is a pure import aggregator, documentation-only, or duplicate.
